February 19, 2024
First notice of loss received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes. The claimant is
represented by counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
April 4, 2024
Reviewed the police report and the photographs submitted by the other driver. Both the witnesses and the other
driver describe the collision the same way, and the damage on the claimant's vehicle lines up with the reported
impact point.
May 21, 2024
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the claimant was in the vehicle at the time and reported neck and
back strain. The described injury is consistent with a lateral impact of this kind.
May 29, 2024
Obtained the claimant's medical records. Treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and follow-up
visits tapering as the claimant improved. No prior injury to the same body area appears in the records.
June 27, 2024
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account matched the account given at first
notice and in earlier conversations with the claimant.
July 27, 2024
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the vehicle damage perdates the coverage period, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is on record.
July 29, 2024
Reviewed the repiar estimate against the photographs and the reported point of impact. The line items align with the
damage pattern, and no unrelated components have been added.
September 12, 2024
File is progressing normally. Liability appears clear based on the police report, witness statements and the other
driver's account, and the bodily injury component is being evaluated against the completed treatment records.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
